subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

My heart fills with anger when I see disciples of self-claimed gods _________ before them.
solution:
The correct answer is '**prostrating**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**prostrating**" means lying stretched out on the ground with one's face downward, often in reverence or submission. (साष्टांग प्रणाम करना)
 
• In the context of the sentence, it indicates extreme reverence or blind devotion to self-proclaimed gods.
 
• This action is often criticized when associated with blind faith or manipulation by so-called spiritual leaders.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *My heart fills with anger when I see disciples of self-claimed gods prostrating__ before them.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Spitting (थूकना)**: Disrespectful and irrelevant in the context of reverence.
 
• **Swinging (झूलना)**: Unrelated action, contextually inappropriate.
 
• **Sleeping (सोना)**: Passive activity, does not convey the sense of worship or devotion.
